outcome: A public immutable practical case exercises multi-label semantics without private files or production-derived expected values.

artifacts.purpose: Complete multi-label references and opaque input

interfaces: Include overlapping expected/predicted sets, empty answered sets, whole abstention with complete marginals, a known failure, two runs and partial selection overlap.
Oracle author calculates counts/rational Brier/analytical logs and transitions without reading production scoring.
Freeze input bytes before expected calculations; manifest hashes exclude itself and do not create circular digest dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit expected raw/final metrics, losses/statuses, selected/answered IDs, recovered/regressed/changed IDs and label transitions exist.
At least one failure can be located by structured correctness and inspected; intersection excludes known IDs.
No generated run output committed as a fixture; only input/oracle evidence is public.

verification.procedure: Freeze fixture hashes, manually derive each expected count and rational Brier plus analytic log expression, and have a separate reviewer reconcile all oracle entries before using Validator.
